title: Simulação de Conjuntos de Dados Falsos
summary: A small Python project that generates synthetic/fake datasets using pandas, random, and faker to support testing without exposing real data; the requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas as dependencies but no code in the repository calls them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.11.0, ctgan==0.9.1, rdt==1.11.0, sdmetrics==0.13.0, copulas==0.9.2; no matching usage in code
needs: No source code call sites found; README describes actual generation via pandas/random/faker, so SDV family may be unused despite being listed as dependencies.
